provenance: Claude bridge727, read and acknowledged before outgoing728.
twisted_square_correction: The abstract two-star matching theorem allows straight and exchanged cross matchings on a singleton Q component. The full root-letter common-neighbour caps exclude the exchanged case. Thus every singleton component of an admissible boundary gives a genuine3x3 grid. This supersedes the broader wording of peer722 and the corresponding journal entry, without changing the kernel theorem.
line_structure: For a line l (a triangle), H_l induced on the36 neighbours of l outside l is cubic. Its number of components is c(l), the intrinsic two-star auxiliary component count. Thus l is special iff H_l is disconnected iff the second largest adjacency eigenvalue of H_l is3.
components: Each component has6r vertices, with r root lines in the corresponding part. Every vertex far from l has exactly r neighbours in this component.
complementary_spectrum: The induced graph on the60 vertices far from l has eigenvalue-4 of multiplicity exactly7+c(l), and eigenvalue3 of multiplicity18.
observations_not_theorems: The peer reports that all891 lines in each of the eight studied SRG(243,22,1,2) examples are special and have a grid. This does not prove that a Conway graph has a special line, or that it has a nonspecial line.
open_status: The local rank31 assertion(A), existence of a special line(B), and existence of a nonspecial line(C) remain open. No Conway graph or asymmetric branch is excluded by these messages.
